title: A Survey on Efficient Large Language Model Training: From Data-centric Perspectives
paper_type_zh: 数据中心的大模型后训练综述
best_for_zh: 关于数据质量、教师生成、筛选和训练预算的数据中心训练综述。
one_line: A 2025 ACL survey that treats data selection, quality, synthesis, compression, and self-evolution as distinct levers in efficient post-training.
一篇把数据选择、质量增强、合成、蒸馏压缩和自进化分开讨论的 2025 ACL 后训练综述。
why: It gives Track0 readers a vocabulary for separating a better dataset from a better sampler, teacher, filter, or training budget.
inclusion_reason: An official 2025 map of data-centric post-training that routes readers from Track0 to instruction data, synthetic demonstrations, distillation, and data-quality or audit work.

title: Problem
问题
html: Large-model post-training is often framed through optimizers, while the actual bottleneck is frequently the cost, quality, and reuse of its data. The official ACL 2025 record at https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.1493/ asks how to make post-training data-efficient under expensive annotation and diminishing returns from scale. This Card supplies a vocabulary for data selection and generation; it does not document a particular instruction or reasoning-data release. Its evaluation surface is the lifecycle of a training-data record, from acquisition and filtering to synthetic generation and compression.

大模型后训练常按优化器来叙述，但真正的瓶颈往往是数据的成本、质量与复用。官方 ACL 2025 页面 https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.1493/ 讨论了在人工标注昂贵、数据规模边际收益递减时如何提高后训练的数据效率。本卡提供数据选择和生成的理解框架；它并不发布某个具体 指令 或 推理数据数据集。其评测面是训练数据记录从获得、过滤到合成与压缩的生命周期。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper's contribution is a data-centric taxonomy with five categories: data selection, data quality enhancement, synthetic data generation, data distillation and compression, and self-evolving data ecosystems. The core idea is that “efficient training data” is not one object: a selected subset, an improved label, a teacher-written example, and a compressed corpus make different provenance and audit claims. The feedback contract is intentionally not unified because the surveyed methods may use humans, teacher models, preferences, rewards, or task verifiers. In this atlas, compare it with post-training surveys for pipeline placement and with primary releases for concrete data evidence.
论文的贡献是一套五类数据中心 分类框架：数据选择、数据质量增强、合成数据生成、数据蒸馏与压缩、自进化数据生态。核心观点是“高效训练数据”并不是单一对象：被挑选的子集、改进的标签、教师写出的示例和压缩后的语料分别提出不同的来源与审计主张。它不统一反馈契约，因为所综述的方法可能使用人类、教师模型、偏好、奖励或任务 验证器。图谱中可用它确定后训练位置，再回到具体发布版本核验数据证据。

title: Method
方法
html: This is a literature survey, not a construction pipeline. It classifies representative post-training approaches according to the five categories in the official abstract and links an author-maintained paper list. For each primary method reused from this map, inspect the original paper or release for prompts, response/trace authorship, filters, teacher identity, sample budget, split policy, license, and contamination controls. The official ACL page and DOI are the citation artifacts; the linked GitHub repository is a paper list, not evidence that one common codebase or dataset reproduces every surveyed result.
这是一篇文献综述，而非数据构建 流程。它按官方摘要的五个类别组织代表性后训练方法，并链接作者维护的论文列表。若从这张图复用某个一级方法，仍需阅读原论文或发布物，核验 提示词、回答或轨迹作者、过滤规则、教师身份、采样预算、划分、许可证和污染控制。ACL 页面与 DOI 是引文 发布产物；所链接的 GitHub 是论文列表，不能据此认定存在能复现所有结论的统一代码或数据集。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The official ACL Anthology record verifies the author list, ACL 2025 Long Papers venue, DOI, pages, and abstract. That abstract explicitly names the five taxonomy categories and the data-efficiency motivation. The Card therefore uses the paper as a verified field map, not as empirical evidence that any particular data-selection method dominates across tasks.
官方 ACL Anthology 页面核验了作者、ACL 2025 Long Papers 会议信息、DOI、页码和摘要。摘要明确列出五个 分类框架类别与数据效率动机。因此，本卡把它作为已核验的领域地图，而非把它当作某个数据选择方法在所有任务上都更优的实证结论。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier surveys commonly organize LLM training by architecture or optimization stage. This work changes the entry point to data operations across post-training and foregrounds the distinction between selecting existing data, improving it, generating it, compressing it, and letting it evolve. Those operations are not new individually; the direction signal is their common audit-oriented taxonomy. Before reuse, check whether a claimed data gain is separable from changes to the base model, teacher, inference budget, or evaluation set.
更早的综述常按模型架构或优化阶段组织训练；本文把入口改为后训练中的数据操作，并突出已有数据选择、质量改进、生成、压缩和自演化之间的差别。每项操作本身并非新发明，方向信号在于把它们放在同一套面向审计的 分类框架中。复用前应检查所谓数据收益是否与基础模型、教师、推理预算或评测集变化混在一起。

title: Limitations
局限
html: It is a survey and does not establish a shared benchmark, dataset license, or uniform contamination protocol for the primary papers. Category boundaries can overlap in multi-stage systems, and the official abstract alone does not supply reproducibility details for individual methods.
它是综述，未为一级论文建立统一 基准、数据许可证或污染协议。多阶段系统可能跨越多个类别，且官方摘要不能替代每个方法的可复现性细节。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: The survey organizes data-centric LLM training around five operations, including selection, quality enhancement, synthetic-data generation, compression, and data-efficient training strategies. It shows that claims about data efficiency can arise from different mechanisms, such as filtering, teacher generation, training budgets, or evaluation design, rather than from a single property of a dataset.
综述以五类操作组织数据中心的 LLM 训练，包括选择、质量增强、合成数据生成、压缩和数据高效训练策略。它表明，关于数据效率的主张可能来自过滤、教师生成、训练预算或评测设计等不同机制，而不是某个数据集单一的固有属性。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Efficient training is not only about using less data; it changes data value through selection, enhancement, synthesis, distillation, and self-improvement. This survey maps those routes without implying that every route has equally mature data or reproducible resources.
高效训练不只是减少数据量，而是围绕选择、增强、合成、蒸馏和自我改进改变数据价值。这篇综述提供的是理解这些路线的地图；它展示研究版图，不等于每一种路线都有同等成熟的数据与复现资源。
